environment.description: Same Lambda deployment but the execution role's DynamoDB policy uses fine-grained access control with leading key condition. The IAM policy includes a Condition block with dynamodb:LeadingKeys ForAllValues:StringEquals set to ${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}, and a separate StringEquals condition on dynamodb:Attributes limited to ['tenantId','reportId','title','createdAt','status']. The templatePath attribute is NOT in the allowed attributes list. Additionally, the Lambda function has a resource-based policy restricting invocation to the specific API Gateway stage ARN, and the DynamoDB table has a separate GSI-based access pattern where templatePath is only readable through a service-linked role used by an internal batch processor.

config.dynamodb_table: reports (PK: tenantId, SK: reportId) with attribute-level restriction
config.api_gateway: REST API with Cognito authorizer, resource policy restricts to VPC endpoint
config.note: templatePath attribute excluded from IAM-allowed attributes projection
